subject: geography
title: Tribal Festivals of India
description: Major tribal festivals across India with their states and significance

content.overview: India's tribal communities celebrate unique festivals reflecting their culture, traditions, and connection to nature.
keyPoints: Hornbill Festival (Nagaland): Festival of festivals, December, all Naga tribes
Bihu (Assam): Three types - Rongali, Kongali, Bhogali, Assamese New Year
Sarhul (Jharkhand): Tribal festival, worship of Sal trees, spring festival
Madai Festival (Chhattisgarh): Tribal festival, celebrated by Gond tribe
Tusu Festival (Jharkhand/West Bengal): Harvest festival, tribal women
Wangala Festival (Meghalaya): Garo tribe, harvest festival, 100 drums
Sohrai Festival (Jharkhand): Cattle festival, tribal art
Karama Festival (Jharkhand/Odisha): Tribal festival, worship of Karam tree
Bastar Dussehra (Chhattisgarh): 75-day festival, unique tribal celebration
Losar Festival (Ladakh): Tibetan New Year, Buddhist tribes
Sangai Festival (Manipur): Manipur festival, Sangai deer
Moatsu Festival (Nagaland): Ao tribe, seed sowing festival
Yemshe Festival (Nagaland): Pochury tribe, harvest festival
Ngada Festival (Nagaland): Rengma tribe, post-harvest festival
Mim Kut Festival (Mizoram): Mizo tribe, harvest festival
Chapchar Kut (Mizoram): Spring festival, bamboo dance
Hornbill Festival (Nagaland): Most famous tribal festival, December 1-10

mnemonics.trick: Nagaland: Hornbill, Moatsu, Yemshe, Ngada | Assam: Bihu | Jharkhand: Sarhul, Tusu, Sohrai, Karama | Chhattisgarh: Madai, Bastar Dussehra | Meghalaya: Wangala | Manipur: Sangai | Mizoram: Mim Kut, Chapchar Kut | Ladakh: Losar
mnemonics.explanation: Remember tribal festivals by state for quick recall

quiz.question: Hornbill Festival is celebrated in:
quiz.explanation: Hornbill Festival is celebrated in Nagaland

quiz.question: Wangala Festival is associated with which tribe?
quiz.explanation: Wangala Festival is associated with Garo tribe of Meghalaya

quiz.question: Bastar Dussehra is celebrated in:
quiz.explanation: Bastar Dussehra is celebrated in Chhattisgarh
